raw_segments.text: As he was thus walking, uttering no sound, except to hail the men aloft, or to bid them
hoist a sail still higher, or to spread one to a still greater breadth, thus to and fro
pacing beneath his slouched hat, at every turn he passed his own wrecked boat, which
had been dropped upon the quarter deck and lay there reversed, broken bow to shattered
At last he paused before it, and as in an already overclouded sky fresh troops of clouds
will sometimes sail across, so over the old man's face there now stole some such added
